error_reason: The Planner incorrectly validated the genealogical information provided by the WebSurfer in Turn 0. The WebSurfer explicitly stated it was searching for 'Anna of Hungary (1226–1270)' based on a Britannica entry where parents were 'Béla IV of Hungary and Maria Laskarina'. The Planner falsely concluded that this Anna (d. 1270) was Constantine Palaiologos's mother and that Maria Laskarina was the answer, failing to recognize that Anna of Hungary (d. 1270) was the wife of Andronikos I and not the wife of Andronikos II. The correct Anna of Hungary, wife of Andronikos II and mother of Constantine, lived c. 1260–1281 and was the daughter of Stephen V and Elizabeth the Cuman. The Planner repeatedly failed to correct this fundamental historical error despite receiving search results pointing to different datasets (Turns 2-14), ultimately failing to identify the correct maternal grandmother.
